title: Labyrinth of Pushdown
description: Labyrinth of Pushdown is a VR game made in Unity for the Meta Quest 2 using the XR plugins. The game is made as a tool to help students visualize some computer science concepts.

title: Slash Combat Tech Demo
description: This project was made using Unreal Engine 5, primarily with C++ and minimal Blueprints, to create Souls-like combat mechanics and enemies as well as other systems, such as items and weapons.

title: Beatshot
description: Beatshot is a rhythm-based arcade game made in Unity where the player must move and shoot enemies in sync to the beat of the game while also avoiding their own bullets that bounce around the level.

title: Impact Miner
description: Impact Miner is an endless runner arcade game with rogue lite mechanics made in Unity where the goal is to collide with minerals to get points and use those points for upgrades to get a further distance in the next run.

title: Ray Tracer
description: This project was made using the Processing software to create a simple ray tracer using linear algebra and vector math that's capable of rendering images of shapes with reflections and refractions.

title: Sonic Mini Project
description: This Unity project was made to simulate the physics and gameplay of the original Sonic the Hedgehog on the Game Gear hand held console.

title: URG Racing
description: URG Racing is an anti-gravity racing game made in the Unity game engine where players race against AI using mechanics such as drifting and items gained from item boxes.

title: FOMO Tracker
description: The FOMO Tracker app is a mobile app created using Google's Flutter app development framework with the Dart programming language that lets a user create an account, login, and browse and view games from a NoSQL database to help them track quests in the games they play.
